posts.headline: The ring is real but the résumé is thin — #FreeMaxx Champions have one championship and a career average finish of 5.5, so this 'dynasty' talk needs to cool off.
posts.detail: Tyrique14 won it all in 2025, but a 14-14 career record and a worst finish of 8th prove this team is closer to boom-or-bust than bulletproof. Repeat or it's a one-hit wonder.

posts.headline: Put it in Ra has the best résumé in the league and zero rings to show for it — that's the definition of choking when it matters.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish with back-to-back top-2 seasons is video-game stuff, but adambarner111 still has that donut in the titles column. All that pedigree means nothing until it means everything.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finished dead last at 12th place with a 4-10 record, and nothing about this offseason suggests that changes.
posts.detail: A .286 win pct and a season that ended in the actual cellar is the kind of track record that gets a fanbase renamed. Prove-it szn starts now, or it's just more of the same.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World has a championship banner hanging but a mediocre 13-15 career mark — which is it, contender or pretender?
posts.detail: Alxgalvn's squad owns a title yet has an average finish of 5.5 and once bottomed out at 8th, proving that ring came with some serious asterisks. The league won't fear you until you do it twice.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh's rookie season ended at 11th place with a 5-9 record — welcome to the league, now welcome to the basement.
posts.detail: A .357 win pct in year one isn't exactly a warning shot to the rest of Titty Committee. Until this changes, SwooshAnoosh is just happy to be here.
